reason: Reviewed the specification statement by statement against the idea and found it faithful, complete and mathematically correct. (1) Scale/geometry: c=(rho/s)^2 with s=sqrt(mean_i||z_i||^2) and rho=0.5 gives R_c=1/sqrt(c)=s/rho=2s and c=0.25/s^2, with units 1/||.||^2 - the rho=s/R_c direction, the radius and the curvature are mutually consistent. (2) Lift: LIFT=tanh(sqrt(c)||v||)v/(sqrt(c)||v||+eps) equals exp_0^c(v), is the identity at c=0, maps into ||.||<1/sqrt(c), and is applied separately to the residual and to the codebook, never to their difference, as in the idea. (3) Distance: the SymPy statements compute MOBIUS(-x,y) with xy=-<x,y> and den=1+2c<-x,y>+c^2||x||^2||y||^2, so DIST=(2/sqrt(c))artanh(min(sqrt(c)||(-x)(+)y||,1-1e-6)) is the exact Poincare-ball distance with the correct 2/sqrt(c) normalisation; the c->0 limit 2||x-y||, d_c(0,exp_0^c(v))=2||v|| and log_0(exp_0(v))=v are all consistent, and the only guard is the artanh clamp. (4) Score/assignment: score_k=D_k-off_k with argmin and ties to the smallest index; r_next=r-a_{k1} unlifted; dequantisation/loss baseline with the straight-through estimator on a_{k1}; no new loss or optimiser. (5) Demand/offset: m_i=sum_j t_ij/sqrt(out_i*in_j+eps) with the summation inside, p_ik=softmax_k(-D_ik/tau) on the PURE distance, b_raw_epoch=num_k/(den_k+eps) as an item-weighted mean, EMA on b_raw only (eta=0.1, init 1, detached/no_grad), b_k=log(1+b_raw/mean_k b_raw); off_k=w*log(1+b_k) with b_k (not b_raw), and w=rho_off*mean_scale/max_k log(1+b_k), rho_off=0.10, mean_scale the epoch-1 item-weighted mean of min_k D_k in the current branch's distance, frozen from epoch 2 - all identical to the idea's equations. The two completions (w=0 during epoch 1; item-weighted rather than per-batch mean_scale) are explicitly documented and the first is provably immaterial because epoch-1 b_k=log 2 is k-independent, so the argmin is unchanged. (6) Gradient path is stated: argmin/no gradient on score, STE on a_{k1}, constants and buffers detached. (7) Both switches do what they claim: BEHAVIOUR_OFF makes b_raw~1 and b_k~log 2 (k-independent) and forces off_k=0 exactly on the flag, giving pure geodesic nearest neighbour; GEOMETRY_OFF sets c=0, lift identity and DIST=2||x-y||, with the demand and mean_scale recomputed in the Euclidean branch so w stays scale-consistent. No sign, scale, limit, dimension or switch defect was found; every mutation a generator could plant is absent.
